## [0.3.1] - 2026-08-19

### [ADD] Features

- *(stages)* Add pre-commit config parser; build(nix): hermetic cargo hooks

- *(stages)* Add and register PreCommitRunnerStage

- *(config)* Make read-write-guard rules configurable via inceptool.toml

- *(config)* Expand read-write-guard built-in rules

- *(read-write-guard)* Support glob/path patterns in guarded-file rules

- *(config)* Add remaining glob/path-based read-write-guard rules

- *(cli)* Add `inceptool config` subcommand and anchor read-write-guard path globs to the repo root

- *(corpus-parser)* Add inceptool-corpus-parser crate for parsing .tests corpus files

- *(parable)* Add inceptool-parable crate, a taint-aware shell command parser

- *(parable)* Add case/elif support and make compound-command parsing strict

- *(risk-data)* Add inceptool-risk-data crate


### [FIX] Bug Fixes

- *(nix)* Remove --offline from clippy git hook

- *(deps)* Update memmap2 to 0.9.11 (RUSTSEC-2026-0186)

- *(ci)* Correct assignee name in cargo-lock-update workflow


### [MOD] Refactor

- *(protocol)* Use AsRef<str> in Driver trait and HookKind::parse

- *(parsers)* Extract flake_lock and pre_commit decoders into inceptool-parsers


### [DOC] Documentation

- Expand CLAUDE.md into full structured rulebook

- Rewrite CLAUDE.md as compact TOML rulebook

- Fix broken intra-doc links

- *(claude)* Document impl_trait_in_params and inline_trait_bounds rules

- *(claude)* Document parser/stage boundary for inceptool-parsers

- List the parable, parsers, and corpus-parser crates


### [SYS] Miscellaneous Tasks

- Enable overflow-checks and deny format_collect in workspace

- Add stale-marker check and cargo doc gate

- Replace cargo-sort with taplo sorting

- *(protocol)* Remove zerovec; replace with Vec<Cow> and Vec<&RawValue>

- *(nix)* Add .pre-commit-config.yaml to .gitignore

- Remove unused flash dependency

- *(parable)* Declare the optional "miette" feature

- Bump miette and regex workspace dependency versions

- *(cargo-lock-update)* Revert only direct-dep updates instead of skipping PR

- *(cargo)* Update transitive dependencies in Cargo.lock

- *(cargo)* Lock new dependencies for risk-data integration
